description:
Make the document link check ask the git module, in one presence-check process, whether unpinned assets missing from the working tree are committed at `HEAD`.

## Background

- `check_document_links` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1097-1370`) opens libgit2 (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1157`). For each unpinned local asset absent from the working tree it calls `check_asset_in_git` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1912-1927`), which accepts any entry `HEAD`'s tree holds at the path: a file, a directory, a symlink or a submodule.
- `git cat-file --batch-check` answers `HEAD:<path>` with the entry's object type for blobs and trees, but reports a submodule's commit as missing, since that object is not in the repository.
- Pinned documents already resolve their assets through pinned target inspection.
- Tests: `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/check_links_tests.rs:887` and the other link-check tests in that file.
- Kept as one change for a build reason: `check_asset_in_git` is private, and an uncalled private function fails the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The check collects the unpinned local assets absent from the working tree and asks, in one `object_types` call on the executor's git checkout, whether `HEAD:<path>` names an object. `check_asset_in_git` no longer exists and the function uses no git2.
- [hard] REQ-02: An asset in the working tree, or committed at `HEAD` as a file, directory or symlink, is present; others are reported missing, and without git only the working tree counts. The link-check tests pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test asserts the behaviour change and fails on today's code: an asset path naming a submodule at `HEAD`, absent from the working tree, is reported missing.
- [hard] REQ-04: A CLI test with the counting stand-in first on `PATH` checks a document citing several assets missing from the working tree and asserts one `cat-file` invocation; today the check runs in libgit2 and records none, so it fails.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: a submodule path no longer counts as a present asset.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.


- Steward ruling 2026-11-04 (9876a23a): 7516ed50 no longer waits for this task. It replaces `validate_external_url` with one timed HTTP agent and a bounded probe pool over distinct URLs in `commands/document.rs`; when this task lands, it adapts the asset-presence check to that pool (second lander adapts).
title: Link checks test asset presence through one git process
